description: Source code for SharedHealthCheckManager class that manages distributed health checks across pods using Redis, including lock acquisition, caching results, and coordination logic.

classes.name: SharedHealthCheckManager
classes.description: Manages distributed health checks across multiple pods with Redis coordination, including lock management and result caching.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the manager with Redis cache, TTLs, and generates a unique pod ID.

methods.name: get_health_check_lock_key
methods.description: Returns Redis key for the global health check lock.

methods.name: get_health_check_cache_key
methods.description: Returns Redis key for cached health check results.

methods.name: get_model_health_check_lock_key
methods.description: Returns Redis key for model-specific health check lock.

methods.name: get_model_health_check_cache_key
methods.description: Returns Redis key for model-specific health check results cache.

methods.name: acquire_health_check_lock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a Redis lock for health check coordination.

methods.name: release_health_check_lock
methods.description: Releases the Redis lock if owned by this pod.

methods.name: get_cached_health_check_results
methods.description: Retrieves cached health check results from Redis if valid and not expired.

methods.name: cache_health_check_results
methods.description: Stores health check results in Redis with timestamp and metadata.

methods.name: perform_shared_health_check
methods.description: Coordinates health checks: uses cache, lock, or runs local check as fallback.

methods.name: is_health_check_in_progress
methods.description: Checks if another pod is currently performing a health check.

methods.name: get_health_check_status
methods.description: Provides current status of health check coordination including lock and cache info.
